//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Just Mob Heads -> Config

Enable Just Mob Heads.//: Whether Just Mob Heads is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

mobSpecificDropChances.//: If enabled, overrides the 'overallDropChance' variable with the specific values.

enableStandardHeads.//: If enabled, allows Creepers, Skeletons and Zombies to drop their heads.

enableLootingEnchant.//: If enabled, the looting enchant will have an effect on the drop chance.

onlyAdultMobsDropTheirHead.//: If enabled, only adult tameable mobs will have a chance to drop their head on death.

overallDropChance.//: Sets the chance of a mob dropping its head if 'mobSpecificDropChances' is disabled. min: 0, max: 1

creeperSkeletonZombieDropChance.//: Sets head drop chance for Zombies, Skeletons and Creepers if 'enableStandardHeads' is enabled. With 'mobSpecificDropChances' enabled, this is the default for their own lines in headchances.txt. min: 0, max: 1

onlyDropHeadsByChargedCreeper.//: When enabled, only drops mob heads if the source on death is a charged creeper. This overwrites the onlyDropHeadsByPlayerKill value.

onlyDropHeadsByPlayerKill.//: When enabled, only drops mob heads if the source on death is from a player.
